prompt: Create a vertical realistic photography image combined with hand-drawn wall doodle art. A young East Asian woman stands quietly on the left side against a plain warm beige indoor wall, full body visible from head to sneakers, softly lit like a casual fashion portrait. She has long straight black hair with bangs, a calm slightly shy expression, and looks sideways toward the doodle. She wears an oversized white T-shirt, very loose khaki cargo pants with large side pockets, and black-and-white chunky sneakers. Her hands are tucked in her pants pockets, posture relaxed and neat. On the right side of the wall, draw a large black charcoal-pencil graffiti version of the same girl, roughly life-size and slightly taller than the real person, but more mischievous and expressive: big surprised eyes, messy long hair, oversized T-shirt, baggy cargo pants, hands in pockets, exaggerated loose stance. Include exactly 5 separate doodle accent elements around the drawn character: three short exclamation rays above the head, one “?!” mark near the upper right of the head, one small star to the right of the torso, one larger star to the right of the hip area, and one curved motion line near the left pocket. Keep the doodle sketchy, energetic, black-gray, with visible scribble shading and imperfect pencil strokes, as if drawn directly on the wall. The real woman casts a soft shadow on the wall to her left. Minimal studio-like room with smooth concrete floor, low white baseboard, no extra props, no watermark, no caption text. Use natural proportions, realistic fabric folds, gentle warm light, and a playful contrast between the quiet real person and her wild illustrated alter ego.

promptZh: 创作一张竖构图的写实摄影与手绘墙面涂鸦艺术相结合的图像。画面左侧站着一位年轻的东亚女性，背景是一面简洁的暖米色室内墙壁，全身可见，从头部到运动鞋，光线柔和，宛如一张随性的时尚肖像。她留着黑色长直发，带有刘海，表情文静略带羞涩，侧头看向涂鸦。她穿着一件超大号的 白色 T 恤，非常宽松的 卡其色 工装裤，裤侧带有大口袋，脚穿黑白拼色厚底运动鞋。她的双手插在裤兜里，姿态放松而整洁。在墙面的右侧，画一个与真人等大、略高一些的黑色炭笔涂鸦版女孩，形象更调皮且富有表现力：大大的惊讶双眼、凌乱的长发、超大号 T 恤、宽松工装裤、双手插兜，姿态夸张松散。在涂鸦角色周围精确添加 5 个独立的装饰元素：头顶上方三道短促的感叹射线，头部右上方一个“?!”符号，躯干右侧一颗小星星，臀部区域右侧一颗较大的星星，以及左侧口袋附近的一条弧形动感线。涂鸦要保持草图感和活力，呈现黑灰色调，带有明显的涂鸦阴影和不完美的铅笔笔触，仿佛直接画在墙上一样。真人女性在左侧墙面上投下柔和的阴影。极简的工作室风格房间，地面为平滑的水泥地，配有低矮的白色踢脚线，无额外道具，无水印，无说明文字。运用自然的比例、逼真的织物褶皱、柔和的暖光，展现文静真人与她狂野插画分身之间的趣味对比。
